title: Phone Segmentation and Recognition through Phonological Activation Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2607.09020v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Phone segmentation and recognition are inherently related tasks, yet modern approaches typically model them separately. We argue that phonetic structure is already latent in the representations of self-supervised speech models (S3Ms), so one only needs to steer them to solve both tasks. We leverage S3M-based Phonological Activation Mapping (SPAM), which maps each S3M representation frame to a vector of phonological feature activations, such as voicing and nasality. On top of SPAM, we introduce two simple but effective lightweight, gradient-descent-free prediction heads: a recognition head and a segmentation head. Our method requires less than a minute of phonetic transcriptions, and the recognition head generalizes to phones unseen during training. Across a diverse range of datasets, our approach attains strong segmentation performance.

translated_title: 通过音系激活映射实现音素分割与识别
translated_abstract: 音素分割与识别是本质上密切相关的任务，然而现代方法通常将它们分开建模。我们认为语音结构已经潜藏于自监督语音模型（S3Ms）的表示之中，因此只需对其进行引导便可同时解决这两个任务。我们利用基于S3M的音系激活映射（SPAM），该方法将每个S3M表示帧映射为一个音系特征激活向量，例如浊音性和鼻音性。在SPAM之上，我们引入了两个简单但有效的轻量级、无需梯度下降的预测头：识别头和分割头。我们的方法仅需不到一分钟的音标转写数据，且识别头能够泛化到训练中未见过的音素。在多种不同的数据集上，我们的方法均取得了出色的分割性能。
tldr: 该论文提出基于自监督语音模型的音系激活映射（SPAM）方法，通过两个轻量级、无需梯度下降的预测头，仅用不到一分钟的音标转写即可同时实现音素分割与识别，并能泛化到训练中未见过的音素。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes S3M-based Phonological Activation Mapping (SPAM) with two lightweight, gradient-descent-free prediction heads that jointly achieve phone segmentation and recognition using less than a minute of transcriptions, while generalizing to unseen phones.
